## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

cumulativeDurationMs — core-domain/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/domain/race/SegmentBuilder.kt

## Trigger

Called from RaceDetailViewModel.buildRow, building each segment row of
the phone's race detail screen — observed

## Today

`cumulativeDurationMs` walks only the `Segment` entries actually
present in the `segments` list it receives and sums their
`durationMs`, silently skipping any index absent from that list.
`RaceRepositoryImpl.deriveSegments` keeps only the indexes that have a
stored `SegmentEntity` row for a race, so an INCOMPLETE race's
`segments` list can genuinely be missing an index — not merely holding
one whose `durationMs` is null. In that case `cumulativeDurationMs`
returns a sum lower than the truth instead of the null its own
documentation promises ("once broken, stays broken", which today only
covers a present entry whose `durationMs` is null). Its only
production caller, `RaceDetailViewModel.buildRow`, falls the null
result back to `0L` (`cumulativeDurationMs(race.segments, index) ?:
0L`), rendering an unavailable cumulative as `0` instead of the
screen's own `MISSING_VALUE` placeholder, built for exactly this case.
On the write side, `RaceDao.insertSegments` is declared `@Insert(
onConflict = OnConflictStrategy.REPLACE)` against the `(raceId,
index)` primary key of `segments`, so a duplicate index arriving on
insert silently replaces the stored row instead of being refused. On
the read side, neither `cumulativeDurationMs`, nor
`CumulativeDeltaEstimator.estimate` and `.finalDelta`, nor
`EndOfRaceViewModel.computeState` deduplicate `Segment` entries by
index before summing — each of the three would add a duplicate index
present in a `segments` list twice.

## Expected

`cumulativeDurationMs` returns null as soon as any index in
`1..throughIndex` has no corresponding entry in `segments`, in
addition to the null it already returns for a present-but-null
`durationMs` — a missing index is treated the same as a null
duration. `RaceDetailViewModel.buildRow` shows `MISSING_VALUE` for the
cumulative and previous-cumulative cells instead of falling
`cumulativeDurationMs`'s null result back to `0L`.
`CumulativeDeltaEstimator.estimate`, `CumulativeDeltaEstimator.finalDelta`
and `EndOfRaceViewModel.computeState` each reject a duplicate index in
their segment list rather than summing every entry found for it — none
of the three currently deduplicates by `Segment.index` before summing.
`RaceDao.insertSegments` refuses a segment carrying an index already
stored for that race instead of replacing it, so a duplicate index is
rejected where the race is written, not silently accepted.

## Searched

cumulativeDurationMs, SegmentBuilder, deriveSegments, insertSegments,
CumulativeDeltaEstimator, EndOfRaceViewModel
